name: Reels Limon
description: Loud, marked series style from the becario-reels pack: lemon-yellow background, electric-blue accent, condensed Anton titles, thick black borders and hard shadows. Word-synced scenes with hard cuts. No emoji.
prompt_hint: Style limon (marked family: hard cuts by default). One sentence = one scene: 8-14 scenes, 25-60 s. narration is exactly what the voice says, with one or two keywords per sentence between *asterisks* (they become accent boxes in the subtitles). Each scene: visual {"type":"reel","reel":{"type":"<scene>", ...fields, "en":[moments]}}. "en" lists, in order, the spoken word that triggers each element of the scene: "word" (accents and case ignored, prefixes work: "anim" = "animación"; numbers without dots or symbols: "1500", "80"), "word#2" (second time it is said), "word+6" / "word-4" (frames later / earlier, 30 = 1 s; combine as "word#2+6"), "inicio" / "fin" (scene start / end) or a frame number. Elements appear 4 frames before the word is heard; moments you leave out are spread automatically. Every "en" word must be said in that scene's narration. Scene types (moments; fields, max chars): headline 1 (texto: big title, "/" breaks lines of <=14 chars, *emphasis* in handwriting; etiqueta <=24; icono or imagenes <=4); chat 5 (mensaje <=38, titulo, saludo, respuesta <=26, archivo, movil {titulo, subtitulo, icono}, pildora <=34, anotacion <=16; moments: types, sends, answers, phone, pill); editor 4 (hecho <=24, archivo, palabras <=4, sonidos <=3); phone 3 (titulo <=24, subtitulo <=18, icono, pegatina <=12, contador {desde, hasta, etiqueta}); counter 2 (valor, etiqueta <=28, desde, prefijo, sufijo like " %", icono, llama: true; counts on 1, hits on 2); stats 1-3 (filas [{valor, etiqueta <=14, detalle <=30, sufijo, destacar}]); card 1-4 (titulo <=18, icono, etiqueta <=14, filas [["label", "value", true?]]); list 2-5 (titulo <=22, items: text <=30 or {texto, icono}); steps 2-4 (pasos <=34 chars each); compare 3 (izquierda, derecha {titulo <=16, texto <=50, icono}, ganador izquierda|derecha|ninguno); strike 2 ("not X but Y": antes <=22, despues <=18, icono, modo "codigo"); objection 2 (texto <=60 without "?", respuesta <=30, numero <=12, intro); quiz 3 (pregunta <=60, opciones 2-4 of <=28, correcta index; put moment 3 on the word that gives the answer); bars 2-5 (barras [{etiqueta <=12, valor}], titulo <=26, unidad <=4, destacar index); image 2 (imagen: local .png/.jpg/.webp path, formato horizontal|cuadrada|vertical, texto <=34, etiqueta <=22, efectos agua|causticas|estrellas|haz|burbujas|rayos|cine|flotar); gallery 2 (imagenes 2-6 local paths, modo abanico|orbita|rejilla, etiqueta <=30); drawing 1-2 (alias dibujo: your own vector drawing {viewBox, parts}, texto, etiqueta; any icono may be a drawing too; visual.fx adds 2D effects); cta 3 (palabra <=12, verbo <=14, texto <=50 with "/", iconos <=5). The pack's Spanish names also work as type (titular, contador, cifras, ficha, lista, pasos, comparacion, tachado, objecion, pregunta, barras, imagen, galeria, movil). Per scene options inside reel: entrada corte|suave|semitono (semitono 1-3 times per reel to mark a new block), sinSubtitulos: true when the text is already on screen (the hook headline and the cta), sfx [["word", "ding", 0.3]] (pop, ding, exito, campana, tecla, tic, clic, whoosh, swoosh, papel, burbuja, golpe, negacion, puff, cristal, proyector, subida), voz: how to pronounce the sentence. Rules: hook first with a concrete headline; one idea per sentence; never the same scene type more than twice in a row; put the first moment on an early word and spread the others over the sentence so nothing stays still more than 0.6 s, but not on the very last word; finish with a cta. Icons: Lucide or Phosphor names (rocket, piggy-bank, brain, code, shield-check). Optional top level: reels {subtitles linea|bloque|no, transition corte|suave|semitono, cover {etiqueta, lineas (<=12 chars each, *accent*), icono, pegatina}}. Real, checked numbers only. Never use emoji.
